title: Quiz: Links Deep Dive
description: Check your understanding of Links Deep Dive.

questions.question: Which of these is the correct way to write a comment in HTML?
questions.explanation: In HTML, <!-- --> marks a comment. Block comments use -->.

questions.question: What does href="#section" do?
options: Jumps to the element with id="section" on the same page
questions.correctAnswer: Jumps to the element with id="section" on the same page
questions.explanation: The # fragment references an element id.

questions.question: True or False: Links with target="_blank" should use rel="noopener" for security.
Fill in the blank: About
questions.explanation: Relative paths resolve from the current page.

questions.question: In HTML, what is the safest way to predict what a program outputs?
options: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.correctAnswer: Depends on the code — trace it line by line
questions.explanation: Read top to bottom, track variable values, and note every output statement.
